paper_title: Molecular Lock: A Versatile Key to Enhance Efficiency and Stability of Organic Solar Cells
source_file: /home/wzfeng/MySearch/PhotoRag/MD/Advanced Materials - 2016 - Cheng - Molecular Lock  A Versatile Key to Enhance Efficiency and Stability of Organic Solar/auto/Advanced Materials - 2016 - Cheng - Molecular Lock  A Versatile Key to Enhance Efficiency and Stability of Organic Solar.md

knowledge_points.content: 4,4'-Biphenol (BPO) is utilized as a 'molecular lock' additive that forms hydrogen bonds specifically with fluorine-containing polymer or small molecule donors in organic solar cell blends.
knowledge_points.evidence: 4,4'-Biphenol (BPO; Figure 1a), a common, cheap chemical, is employed as a 'molecular lock' in blends of F-containing polymer and small molecule donors and fullerene acceptors to lock donor via hydrogen bond formed between the donor and BPO.

knowledge_points.content: The addition of 3% BPO to PTB7-th:PC71BM based organic solar cells increases the average power conversion efficiency (PCE) from 8.33% to 8.88%.
knowledge_points.evidence: After the addition of 3% BPO... the average PCE of PTB7-th:PC71BM-based devices increases from 8.33% to 8.88%.

knowledge_points.content: The interaction between BPO and fluorine-containing donors is mediated by an O-H...F hydrogen bond, which is stronger than the O-H...O hydrogen bonds formed between BPO molecules themselves.
knowledge_points.evidence: In PTB7:PC71BM blend, the addition of BPO leads to the occurrence of a new peak at 3268 cm-1 due to the formation of O-H...F hydrogen bond between PTB7 and BPO... O-H...F hydrogen bond is stronger than O-H...O hydrogen bond.

knowledge_points.content: BPO enhances the π-π ordering in 'face-on' oriented polymer domains, which leads to enhanced light absorption in the 500-700 nm range and improved hole mobility.
knowledge_points.evidence: In contrast to the films without BPO, both the films with BPO fresh-made and heated show an obvious π-π stacking peak (q ≈ 1.7 Å-1) along the qz-axis, indicating an enhanced π-π ordering in 'face-on' orientated polymer domains... the absorption between 500 and 700 nm is enhanced.

knowledge_points.content: The formation of the O-H...F hydrogen bond between PTB7 and BPO is characterized by a specific FTIR vibration peak at 3268 cm⁻¹.
knowledge_points.evidence: In PTB7:PC71BM blend, the addition of BPO leads to the occurrence of a new peak at 3268 cm-1 due to the formation of O-H...F hydrogen bond between PTB7 and BPO.

knowledge_points.content: The hole mobility of PTB7:PC71BM blends increases from 3.48 × 10⁻³ cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹ to 9.05 × 10⁻³ cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹ upon the addition of BPO.
knowledge_points.evidence: The hole mobility increases with the addition of BPO (9.05 × 10-3 vs 3.48 × 10-3 cm2 V-1 s-1) while the electron mobility is slightly changed.

knowledge_points.content: BPO significantly enhances thermal stability; PTB7:BPO:PC71BM devices retain 80% of their original PCE after heating at 130 °C for 120 minutes, compared to only 40% retention for devices without BPO.
knowledge_points.evidence: The PCE of PTB7:PC71BM based devices without BPO decays from 7.35% to 2.96%... preserving only 40%... After heating at 130 °C for 120 min the PCE of PTB7:BPO:PC71BM-based devices decays from 7.87% to 6.26%... preserving 80% of its original value.

knowledge_points.content: BPO optimizes vertical phase separation by suppressing the migration of polymer donors to the top surface, resulting in a decrease of PTB7 molar content at the surface from 41.3% to 30.1%.
knowledge_points.evidence: The top surface molar content of PTB7 decreases from 41.3% to 30.1% with the addition of BPO, as dense polymer network formed via the hydrogen bond suppresses the migration of polymers to the top surface.

knowledge_points.content: The optimal concentration of the BPO molecular lock for fluorine-containing donor/fullerene solar cells is 3% by weight relative to the total weight of the active layer components.
knowledge_points.evidence: The F-containing donor/fullerene solar cells exhibit the best performance with addition of 3% BPO.

knowledge_points.content: The efficiency and stability enhancement provided by BPO is selective to fluorine-containing donors; donors lacking fluorine, such as P3HT and PBDTTT-C-T, show no significant performance or stability change with BPO addition.
knowledge_points.evidence: In contrast, the PCEs for donors without F atoms almost keep unchanged with the addition of 3% BPO (7.14% vs 7.14% for PBDTTT-C-T:PC71BM-based devices and 3.84% vs 3.83% for P3HT:PC71BM-based devices).
